name: ECHO Datacenter GmbH Kevelaer colocation/data-center services

name: NetCologne Lövenich sustainable data center
notes: NetCologne announced construction in Cologne-Lövenich in November 2023 with six initial data-center rooms; later listings report opening in September 2024 and 5 MW capacity.

notes: Official DOKOM21 pages state it operates geographically separated Ruhr-area/Dortmund data centers with over 4,600 m2 of data-center area, including Hörde and newer Huckarde capacity.

name: EXA Dortmund data center

name: euNetworks Colocation Dortmund

name: Knipp Dortmund data center

name: DU-IT main data center

name: Rhine Cloud hosted by DU-IT in Duisburg
